title: Agamemnon restrains Menelaus
intro: Agamemnon stops Menelaus from fighting Hector. Nestor shames the silent Greeks.

notes.text: φαίνομαι, appear: 3sg aor pass; κε + aor indicative, “would have appeared” (unreal past); τοι = σοι.
βίοτος, life; τελευτή, end; παλάμη, palm / hand: dat pl, “at Hector’s hands.”
φέρτερος, stronger: comparative of ἀγαθός; ἦεν = ἦν, 3sg impf of εἰμί.
ἀναΐσσω, spring up: aor ptc nom pl; αἱρέω, seize: 3pl 2aor, unreal condition “had not seized.”
κρείων, ruling: pres ptc, formulaic; εὐρύ, widely, adverbial acc.
δεξιτερός, right: gen sg, the part by which he was taken; ἕλε, 3sg 2aor of αἱρέω.

notes.lemma: ἔπος τ᾽ ἔφατ᾽ ἔκ τ᾽ ὀνόμαζεν
notes.text: φημί, say: 3sg impf; ἐξονομάζω, call by name: tmesis, 3sg impf.
ἀφραίνω, be foolish: 2sg pres; διοτρεφής, nourished by Zeus: voc.

notes.lemma: οὐδέ τί σε χρὴ ταύτης ἀφροσύνης
notes.text: χρή + acc of person and gen of thing: “you have no need of this folly”; ἀφροσύνη, folly.
ἀνέχω, hold back: tmesis, 2sg 2aor imperative mid, σχέο = σχοῦ.
κήδομαι, be troubled: pres ptc; περ, even though.
ἐθέλω, be willing: 2sg imperative; ἔρις, strife: “out of rivalry.”
σεῦ = σοῦ, gen of comparison; ἀμείνων, better: dat sg; φώς, man.
στυγέω, hate: 3pl pres, uncontracted; τε, generic “whom even others dread.”
καὶ δέ, even; κυδιάνειρα, man-glorifying: dat sg fem, epithet of battle.
ῥιγέω, shudder: 3sg perf, pres sense “shrinks”; ἀντιβολέω, meet: aor inf.
σέο = σοῦ, gen of comparison; πολλόν, by far, adverbial; ἀμείνων, better.
ἵζω, sit: 2sg imperative mid; ἔθνος, band / company; ἑταῖρος, comrade: gen pl.
πρόμος, champion; ἀνίστημι, raise up: 3pl fut.
ἀδειής, fearless; ἀκόρητος, insatiable of + gen μόθου, tumult of battle.
ἀσπασίως, gladly; κάμπτω, bend: fut inf, i.e. sit down in relief.
φεύγω, flee / escape: 3sg 2aor subj, -σι ending.
δήϊος, hostile; δηϊοτής, fighting: gen sg.
παραπείθω, win over: 3sg aor; ἀδελφειός, brother: gen sg.
αἴσιμος, fitting: neut pl; παρεῖπον, speak persuasively: aor ptc.
πείθομαι, obey: 3sg impf; ὃ δ᾽, he (Menelaus).
γηθόσυνος, glad; αἱρέομαι, take off: 3pl 2aor mid; τοῦ … ἀπ᾽ ὤμων, from his shoulders.
ἀνίστημι, rise: mid 3sg impf; μετεῖπον, speak among.
ὢ πόποι, alas; πένθος, grief; ἱκάνω, come to: 3sg pres.
Ἀχαιΐς, Achaean: fem acc sg; the grief that comes on all Achaea.
οἰμώζω, wail: 3sg aor opt, potential with κε.
ἱππηλάτης, horse-driving: epic nom sg masc in -α.
βουληφόρος, counsellor; ἀγορητής, speaker; ἠδέ = καί; Μυρμιδόνων, of the Myrmidons.
εἴρομαι, ask: pres ptc mid; γηθέω, rejoice: 3sg impf, uncontracted.
ἐνί after its noun, in his own house; ἐρέω, ask about: pres ptc nom sg.
γενεή, lineage; τόκος, offspring; Nestor was asked about the Greek heroes’ ancestry.
πτώσσω, cower: pres ptc acc pl; ἀκούω, hear: 3sg aor opt, protasis; ὑφ᾽ Ἕκτορι, under Hector.
ἀείρω, lift: tmesis, 3sg aor opt, apodosis with κεν; ἀθανάτοισι dat of the gods; φίλας … χεῖρας, hands.
μέλος, limb: gen pl; δύω, sink: aor inf, a wish that the spirit leave the limbs.
Ἅιδης, gen Ἄϊδος; εἴσω, into; Peleus would wish to die rather than hear this.
